class.name: VideoStreamCineForm
class.description: A [VideoStream] resource that plays back CineForm video from a Matroska file, as written by the CineForm [MovieWriter]. Pass it to a [VideoStreamPlayer] to play it. Every CineForm frame is a keyframe, so seeking does not decode the frames before the target. Playback requires an x86 CPU. A Matroska file can carry any codec. This resource claims a file only if its video track is CineForm, so a [code].mkv[/code] holding something else is left to another loader.
